focusUp.label: Go to parent level
focusUp.description: From a manifestation go to its expression, from an expression go to its work.

focusDown.label: Go to child level
focusDown.description: From a work enter its expressions, from an expression enter its manifestations.

listUp.label: Move selection up
listUp.description: Move to the previous item in the active WEM or Agents list (works in detached windows too).

listDown.label: Move selection down
listDown.description: Move to the next item in the active WEM or Agents list (works in detached windows too).

nextWorkspace.label: Switch workspace (right)
nextWorkspace.description: Activate the next tab of any type (WEM, Agents, SPARQL); wraps to first.

previousWorkspace.label: Switch workspace (left)
previousWorkspace.description: Activate the previous tab of any type (WEM, Agents, SPARQL); wraps to last.

toggleBacklinks.label: Toggle backlinks panel
toggleBacklinks.description: Expand or fold backlinks in the current WEM or Agents workspace.

toggleList.label: Toggle entity list
toggleList.description: Hide or show the entity/agent list on the left (main or detached window).

toggleIntermarc.label: Toggle Intermarc width
toggleIntermarc.description: Expand or contract the Intermarc pane in WEM or Agents tabs.

toggleDetachTab.label: Pop/dock current tab
toggleDetachTab.description: Detach the active WEM/Agents tab into a window or dock it back.

arrangeTile.label: Tile windows
arrangeTile.description: Arrange main + detached windows in a grid.

arrangeCascade.label: Cascade windows
arrangeCascade.description: Arrange main + detached windows in a cascade.
